Shi scrabbling in the dust for that ring looked just like a starving dog. 
Weiyang City had already stolen his livelihood. Now here he was, clawing for a piece of jade thrown out by a Wen, his sworn enemy. 
Once, he might've hated himself for this. But now, all he wanted was to live. 
He finally understood. In this world, dignity is worth nothing. Whoever has money can buy all the dignity they want. So he made up his mind. To hell with dignity, he would survive. With this jade ring, he'd make his comeback. He wanted money, piles of it, enough to buy back everything he'd lost. 
After that day, the shouting peddler Shi vanished from the streets. And a ruthless man named Shi Zhen emerged in Weiyang City.
